title: Zelenskyy: Putin choosing war by rejecting offer for in-person talks
content: Zelenskyy: Putin choosing war by rejecting offer for in-person talks Zelenskyy: Putin choosing war by rejecting offer for in-person talks Russian President Vladimir Putin has turned down an offer for in-person talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, saying he sees no point in meeting. Zelenskyy said Russia “has again chosen war” by rejecting his open letter appealing for a face-to-face meeting. Published On 5 Jun 2026
